entities.name: Public network integrated non-public network
entities.description: A network made available by dedicated DNNs or S-NSSAIs, optionally using CAG to restrict access.

entities.name: Closed Access Group
entities.description: Mechanism to prevent UEs not allowed to access a PNI-NPN from accessing it.

entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: List provisioned by network and stored in UE's non-volatile memory, containing allowed CAG lists and access indications.

entities.name: Generic UE configuration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to provision CAG information list from network to UE.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to provision CAG information list from network to UE.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to provision CAG information list from network to UE.

entities.name: Network-initiated de-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to provision CAG information list from network to UE.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
entities.description: UE state where CAG information list is preserved in non-volatile memory.

entities.name: USIM insertion condition
entities.description: Condition where UE stores CAG information list from USIM to ME if no list exists or SUPI doesn't match.

entities.name: Emergency registration condition
entities.description: Condition allowing UE to perform initial registration for emergency services via non-CAG cell or CAG cell not in allowed list.

entities.name: AMF behavior condition
entities.description: Condition where AMF behaves as specified when UE camps on CAG cell with no allowed CAG-IDs or non-CAG cell with CAG-only indication.

relations.description: PNI-NPN optionally uses CAG to prevent unauthorized UE access.
Generic UE configuration update procedure provisions CAG information list.
Registration procedure provisions CAG information list.
Service request procedure provisions CAG information list.
Network-initiated de-registration procedure provisions CAG information list.
CAG information list is preserved when UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
USIM insertion condition establishes storage of CAG information list from USIM to ME.
Emergency registration is allowed when CAG cell is not in allowed CAG list.
AMF behavior condition establishes specific AMF behavior based on CAG information list content.
